entities.summary: Sir James Wylie, 1st Baronet, was a Scottish physician who served as a battlefield surgeon and as a court physician in the Russian Empire from 1790 until his death in 1854, and as president from 1808 to 1838 of both the Medical-Surgical Academy at Saint Petersburg and its annex at Moscow. He is considered one of the foremost contributors to the development of military medicine in Russia by some by whom the role of the indigenous Russian Nikolay Ivanovich Pirogov as the "father of combat medicine" may appear to be less valued.
